entity: Department of Housing and Urban Development
role: Federal agency, commenter on Section 4(f) land review
stance_basis: states awareness of no significantly harmful effect from temporary 4(f) land use, and separately concurs with no adverse environmental impact on low-income neighborhoods
summary: The Department of Housing and Urban Development provided two separate comments: one during early coordination noting no significantly harmful effect from the temporary use of Section 4(f) land west of Thorn Creek Bridge, and one in response to the Draft Environmental Statement finding no adverse environmental impact on low-income neighborhoods. Both comments are non-objecting and supportive of the project proceeding, but neither explicitly advocates for the project.
complaint_summary: HUD, after reviewing the Draft Environmental Statement in coordination with its Regional Office and affected community action agencies, found no reason to believe the proposed action would have an adverse environmental impact on the low-income neighborhoods involved.
summary_quote: We are aware of no significantly harmful effect that the temporary use of this 4(f) land west of Thorn Creek Bridge would have on this area.

mentions.quote: The subject proposal requires no comment from this Department
